[[Lord/Legends|Lord]] '''Felmas''' was the [[chief designer]] and [[Chief Executive Officer/Legends|CEO]] of [[Abhean Shipyards]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]]. Under Felmas, [[Abhean/Legends|Abhean]] Shipyards built and maintained container vessels for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Supply Corps]].<ref name="FaDCR" />
